title: onboard-lyra-7b-v1.0-metadata-perf-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add Lyra-7B v1.0 to model registry with curated metadata and perf profiles
Changelog automation updated to include Lyra on release feed
Small docs page for Lyra model and usage recommendations
description: Onboard Lyra-7B v1.0 to the model registry. Motivation: Lyra is a new community model with favorable latency/cost tradeoffs for short-to-medium sequences and shows strong alignment with our serving runtime when using the recommended quantization profile. This PR adds canonical metadata, performance profiles for common instance types, and wires the model to our changelog/release notes automation so downstream consumers (console, API model catalog) display correct versioning and perf guidance. Changes include: metadata YAML, perf profile JSON for v1.0, docs page, unit tests, and updates to the changelog sync script to pick up new model metadata. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata file registry/models/lyra/metadata.yaml with model name, architecture, tokenizer_hint, default_quantization_profiles, recommended_max_seq_len, and license. - [x] Add perf profile registry/models/lyra/perf_profiles/v1.0.json with throughput/latency samples for g4dn, gn5, and qpu-backed runners. - [x] Implement small validation tests tests/test_lyra_metadata.py to ensure keys and profile schema match registry contract. - [x] Update docs/docs/models/lyra.md with quickstart and serving recommendations. - [x] Ensure changelog automation scripts (scripts/changelog-sync.py) include lyra entries and surfaced release notes. - [x] CI green and reviews addressed. Related: ENG-4821 model onboarding epic; SUP-1128 customer request to evaluate Lyra for dedicated pools.

merge_commit_message: Onboard Lyra-7B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, docs, and changelog automation
notes_for_maintainers: Perf profiles were generated from internal microbenchmarks on g4dn.12xlarge-like instances using the benchmark harness; numbers are sample-based and labeled as 'representative' in the profile file.
If adding additional quantization profiles, update scripts/validators/perf_profile_validator.py to accept new keys.
Changelog automation picks up registry/_index.json; ensure CI job has access to model metadata before cutting release.
post_merge_actions: Schedule perf-canary for Lyra in dedicated staging
notes_about_tests: Added unit tests that validate required metadata keys and perf profile schema. Integration tests are not included in this PR because they require staging GPU resources; a follow-up will add canary runs in perf-canary pipeline.
regression_risks: Low. Changes are additive to registry and docs. Perf profiles are metadata only; runtime changes are not included in this PR.
authors_reply_summary: Addressed reviewer nits: clarified units, confirmed quantization compatibility, fixed lint errors, expanded docs with quickstart and caveats. CI reran green and reviewer approvals collected.
